@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+import hashlib
+import jwt
+import datetime
+from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/auth")
+
+JWT_SECRET = "supersecretkey123"
+JWT_ALGORITHM = "HS256"
+
+USERS = {
+    "admin": hashlib.md5(b"admin123").hexdigest(),
+    "user1": hashlib.md5(b"password").hexdigest(),
+}
+
+
+class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
+    username: str
+    password: str
+
+
+@router.post("/login")
+def login(request: LoginRequest) -> dict:
+    hashed = hashlib.md5(request.password.encode()).hexdigest()
+    if request.username not in USERS or USERS[request.username] != hashed:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid credentials")
+
+    payload = {
+        "sub": request.username,
+        "iat": datetime.datetime.utcnow(),
+    }
+    token = jwt.encode(payload, JWT_SECRET, algorithm=JWT_ALGORITHM)
+    return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer"}
+
+
+@router.post("/change-password")
+def change_password(username: str, old_password: str, new_password: str) -> dict:
+    old_hashed = hashlib.md5(old_password.encode()).hexdigest()
+    if username not in USERS or USERS[username] != old_hashed:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")
+    USERS[username] = hashlib.md5(new_password.encode()).hexdigest()
+    return {"status": "password changed"}
planted_issues: MD5 used for password hashing — cryptographically broken (security.md § Password Handling)
JWT_SECRET hardcoded in source — must be loaded from environment variable (security.md § Secret Management)
JWT token has no expiry (exp claim) — violates 24-hour access token rule (security.md § JWT and Session Tokens)
Passwords stored in in-memory dict — lost on restart, no database persistence
Return type annotated as dict instead of a Pydantic model (python.md § Pydantic Models)
